_comment: Inputs for gen_power_tree.py. Everything the schematic cannot tell us (off-board loads, datasheet currents, efficiencies) lives here, each with a source. 'expect' is a substring that must appear in the schematic value of that ref, so a renumbered or swapped part fails the generator instead of silently producing a stale tree.

module.source: Mean Well IRM-90 spec: 6.7 A / 80.4 W convection-rated, 7.37 A peak for 10 s, 92% typ (design-decisions.md)

furnace.source: CMU Tube Furnace 4 page: heater should draw no more than 1000 W (design-decisions.md)

regulator.source: cap_A: design-decisions.md (AP63205, 2 A); eff: ASSUMPTION, not in the repo datasheets
cap_A: design-decisions.md (AP63203, 2 A); eff: ASSUMPTION, not in the repo datasheets
cap_A: Pico 2 3V3(OUT) limit 300 mA (pin-map.md); eff: ASSUMPTION for the Pico's on-board converter

loads.name: 12 V tap A
loads.source: design-decisions.md: 1 A nominal / 2 A peak per 12 V tap

loads.name: 12 V tap B
loads.source: design-decisions.md: 1 A nominal / 2 A peak per 12 V tap

loads.name: ESC (XT60)
loads.source: design-decisions.md: ESC 12 V / 5 A continuous (spin coater, about 60 W)

loads.name: Fan header (Noctua NF-A8 PWM)
loads.source: design-decisions.md: about 60 mA typ / 80 mA max from search summaries; Noctua datasheet not opened (UNVERIFIED)

loads.name: 5 V tap A
loads.source: design-decisions.md: tap rated about 500 mA, used as both nominal and peak demand. The current limit is computed from the schematic's ILIM resistor with the TPS2553 datasheet equations (IOS min = 25230 / R^1.016, IOS max = 22980 / R^0.94, R in kOhm)

loads.name: 12 V rail LED and 12 V sense dividers
loads.source: computed: (12 V - 2 V) / 4.7 k = 2.1 mA, plus 3 sense dividers 12 V / 43 k = 0.28 mA each

loads.name: 5 V rail: ACS712, SSR input, LED, tap sense, TPS2553 IQ
loads.source: ACS712 10 mA typ / 13 mA max (datasheet), SSR input 12 mA max when on (Fotek), LED 2 mA, 2 sense dividers 0.34 mA each, 2 x TPS2553 0.12 mA max each

loads.name: 3.3 V rail: LED, tap pull-downs, TPS2553 IQ, EN pull-ups
loads.source: LED 1.9 mA, 2 tap pull-downs 0.33 mA each, 2 x TPS2553 0.12 mA max each; peak adds 7 EN pull-ups of 0.33 mA when every tap is switched off

loads.name: Pico 2 (VSYS from the 5 V rail)
loads.source: nominal: Pico 2 datasheet Table 2 typical 12.7 mA at 5 V with GPIOs unconnected; peak 0.1 A is an ASSUMPTION covering GPIO drive and USB

loads.name: 3V3(OUT): 3 x INA226, I2C pull-ups, NTC dividers
loads.source: INA226 330 uA typ / 420 uA max each (datasheet), 2 NTC dividers 0.17 mA each at 25 C; I2C pull-ups only draw while pulling low (ignored)
